tour.overview:
The Dana Biosphere Reserve is Jordan's largest nature reserve, stretching from the highlands at 1,500 metres down to the desert of Wadi Araba below sea level. In that descent, it crosses Mediterranean, Irano-Turanian, Saharan and Sudanian zones, home to ibexes, wolves, sand cats and hundreds of plant species. At its foot, Feynan was one of the great copper-mining centres of the ancient world, and is now home to an award-winning ecolodge lit by candles at night.

This private two-day trip takes you on the classic Dana-to-Feynan trail with a licensed guide, with a night at Feynan.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 2 days, 1 night
• Start: your hotel in Amman or Petra
• End: your hotel in Petra or Amman
• Type: private hike with licensed guide; vehicle transfers; 1 night at Feynan Ecolodge with meals
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, the lodge and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: moderate; a 14-kilometre downhill hike

WHAT YOU SEE
• Dana village.
• The Dana-to-Feynan trail.
• Feynan Ecolodge.
• Bedouin life.
• The copper mines.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private guide sets the pace and points out wildlife and plants, and the trail is one-way with your luggage transferred.

WHO IT SUITS
Walkers, nature lovers and travellers seeking quiet.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For a shorter walk, a half-day trail from Dana village can be arranged.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The trail is about 14 kilometres and mostly downhill, taking 5 to 6 hours. Summer is very hot in Feynan; the best seasons are spring and autumn.

days.name: Dana village and the trail down to Feynan
days.description:
What to expect: a long downhill hike through the reserve.

Your driver collects you early and drives to Dana, a 15th-century village of stone houses on the edge of the canyon. With your guide, you start the trail down Wadi Dana, through juniper and pistachio trees, then oleanders and acacias as you descend, with views of the red and white sandstone walls. You may see Nubian ibexes on the cliffs and griffon vultures overhead. After a picnic lunch, you reach Feynan Ecolodge in the late afternoon. In the evening, the lodge is lit only by candles; you join a stargazing session on the roof.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
07:00 – Pick-up.
09:00 – Start of the trail in Dana.
12:30 – Picnic lunch.
15:30 – Arrival at Feynan Ecolodge.
19:00 – Vegetarian dinner.
20:30 – Stargazing.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your luggage is driven around to Feynan.

INCLUDED: transfer, guide, entrance, lunch, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: drinks.

Overnight: Feynan Ecolodge.
Meals: lunch, dinner.

days.name: Bedouin life, the copper mines and the return
days.description:
What to expect: the culture and history of Feynan.

After breakfast, you visit a Bedouin family for coffee and learn about their life in Wadi Feynan, and walk to the ancient copper mines and slag heaps, worked from the Bronze Age to the Byzantine period. After lunch at the lodge, your driver takes you back to Petra or Amman.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
07:30 – Breakfast.
08:30 – Bedouin coffee.
10:00 – Copper mines walk.
12:30 – Lunch.
13:30 – Transfer.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Learning to bake shrak bread with Bedouin women can be arranged.

INCLUDED: guide, lunch, transfer.
NOT INCLUDED: tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: breakfast, lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: How difficult is the hike?
faq.answer: Moderate: about 14 kilometres, mostly downhill, on rocky paths.

faq.question: What is Feynan Ecolodge like?
faq.answer: A solar-powered lodge run with the local Bedouin community, with simple, comfortable rooms and candlelight at night.

faq.question: Is the food vegetarian?
faq.answer: Yes, Feynan serves delicious vegetarian meals.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes, for children used to long walks.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: No; it requires a long hike. Feynan can be reached by vehicle instead.

faq.question: What happens to our luggage?
faq.answer: It is driven to Feynan for you.

faq.question: Can we do it in summer?
faq.answer: It is very hot from June to August; we recommend other seasons.

faq.question: What wildlife might we see?
faq.answer: Ibexes, rock hyraxes, vultures and many birds; wolves and sand cats are rarely seen.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Hiking boots, a hat, sun protection, layers and a daypack.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: March to May and October to November.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Jordan: guides and drivers appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 72 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
